office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the Superior Court, keeping its case files and records, managing court funds and supporting courtroom operations.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Chief Deputy Clerk Ruby Ochoa (Prefers Republican Party), in the office since 2014, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Chief Deputy Clerk of Franklin County since 2014 after 25 years as a paralegal; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Earlier 25 years as a paralegal in private practice [S1]
Board president of Benton Franklin Legal Aid [S1]
